source.attribution: Daily OISST data provided by NOAA PSL, Boulder, Colorado, USA; blended satellite/in-situ analysis, not independent Argo validation. Archive and acquisition hashes are pinned.

limitations: Detector thresholds and regional/profile support rules are versioned prototype choices, not scientific or operational approval.
Missing days remain unknown and cannot join events. Window boundaries disclose censoring; historical evidence is not live monitoring.
Sparse profiles form point-support diagnostics only, never a dense SST heatwave polygon.
Connected components can split or merge; retained runs preserve exact source, baseline, policy and calculation identities.
Independent expert-event, quiet-period false-alert, source cadence, coastal and production audits remain unproven.
